# Rust third-party notices

These license files come from the exact crate source versions selected by `Cargo.lock` for the Linux x86-64 release. The table records each crate’s published SPDX expression. All license, copying, and notice files supplied at each crate root are included; this does not change the original license choice offered by the crate. Review this bundle when updating dependencies. External runtime tools and system libraries are supplied by the target distribution and are documented in the project README.
